label: copy-phase input j, re-fed as the 3rd-5th copied token
explanation: Fires almost only on copy-phase steps whose input is the letter j (99.6% of activation mass); it never fires in the original or delimiter phases. Position matters a lot: it is strongest when j is the re-fed copy of original token 2 or 3 (recall_idx 3-4, about 84% of mass) and weaker at recall_idx 5. It is essentially silent when j comes back early in the copy (recall_idx <= 2) and weak late in the copy. The top activations are j at recall_idx 3 in long sequences, often followed by a digit or x. It usually fires only once per sequence. Precision is limited: about half of j inputs in the 3-5 window stay below threshold, and the profile did not show any variable that cleanly separates them. Nearly all activation outside j is tiny and sits on 1, x, or h.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: j, 1, x, h, n, m; least: k, r, p, g) and the token being output (most: x, 1, m, 0, c, h; least: p, b, k, -); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, L=9 & t=13.
